subject: Dedicated reservation options — baseline + surge plan for BrightWell Labs
messages:
From: Alicia Reed <alicia@brightwell.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Cho <dan@brightwell.ai>, procurement@brightwell.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Dedicated — ballpark sizing + timeline request

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the performance was solid and the team is excited. We're starting to pull together a recommendation for leadership between two paths: (A) a smaller dedicated baseline with on-demand burst and (B) a larger committed cluster to simplify ops.

Can you send a short options pack we can share with finance and procurement covering:
- three cluster sizing scenarios (conservative / production baseline / scalable) with min GPU commitments,
- recommended 90-day ramp schedule and warm-pool strategy,
- SLA/latency expectations and fallback behavior if we hit burst limits,
- high-level pricing bands (list price + illustrative discounted commit tiers).

We'd like to present this at our exec sync on June 10.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Reed
Head of AI Infrastructure, BrightWell Labs


From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Reed <alicia@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated — ballpark sizing + timeline request

Hi Alicia — thanks, happy to. Attached is a concise options pack (brightwell_reserved_options_v1.pdf) and the pricing_workbook.xlsx with example burns for each scenario. High level summary below; full detail in the PDF.

Summary (brief):
1) Conservative baseline (Pilot lane) — 8 A100-equivalent GPUs min
   - Use: model evaluation, low-latency critical subsets, heavy KV caching for hot models
   - Ramp: 0 -> 8 over 30 days (prep + model import),
   - Burst: up to +50% via burst pool (on-demand at higher per-token rates),
   - SLA: 95th pct latency target 120ms for 512-token average; fallback to smaller variant model if burst exhausted.

2) Production baseline (Recommended starter) — 24 A100-equivalent GPUs min
   - Use: primary inference traffic for customer-facing features, steady throughput, KV cache population
   - Ramp: staged 0 -> 12 (30 days) -> 24 (90 days) with automatic canary on model versions,
   - Burst: +100% capacity via reserved burst lanes + elastic on-demand,
   - SLA: 95th pct latency 90ms for typical workloads; automated routing to warm standby region if sustained deficit.

3) Scale-first (Operational simplicity) — 64 A100-equivalent GPUs min
   - Use: heavy throughput, multi-model parallelism, long-context workloads, higher concurrency
   - Ramp: 0 -> 32 (30 days) -> 64 (120 days) with dedicated warm-pool sizing,
   - Burst: +150% with multi-region fallback and queued request shedding for non-critical jobs,
   - SLA: 95th pct latency 70ms, prioritized preemption policies for non-critical batch jobs.

Key ops notes:
- Warm-pool recommendation: pre-warm ~20% of target cluster for first 14 days after activation to avoid cold starts for KV-heavy models.
- Decommit grace: 30-day trailing burn measurement to allow staging down gently.
- Fallbacks: model variant swapping (quantized smaller model) + regional routing to avoid user-visible errors.

I'll leave pricing assumptions in the workbook (three commitment tiers). Happy to jump on a 30-minute call with procurement and finance this week to walk the pack.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Dan Cho <dan@brightwell.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Reed <alicia@brightwell.ai>, procurement@brightwell.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated — ballpark sizing + timeline request

Sofia — this is really helpful. A couple quick clarifying Qs from finance / CTO:
1) For the Production baseline (24 GPUs) can you show an example burn at 60% utilization vs 85% utilization? We want to see cost per 1M tokens for both.
2) What's the minimum notice period for scaling up burst slots in a month where we hit product-market demand spikes?
3) Any recommended credits or trial runway for the first 30 days while we validate traffic patterns?

If you can call out those three explicitly in the workbook I'll bring it to the exec sync.

Thanks — Dan
Dan Cho, CTO, BrightWell Labs

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: BrightWell follow-up (scaling examples + promo run)

Sofia / Ben — responding to Dan's ask:
- Action 1: add two utilization slices to pricing_workbook.xlsx for production baseline: 60% and 85% (columns G-H). Use conservative per-GPU effective token throughput of 200k tokens/hour at 60% and 280k tokens/hour at 85% for cost-per-1M-token calc.
- Action 2: minimum notice for burst slot expansion: 2 hours for auto-burst (if capacity available), 48 hours for guaranteed reserved burst allocation (we'll mark this in the proposal).
- Action 3: offer: 30-day trial credits equal to 10% of the first-month committed value for baseline deals >= $75k ARR, or a flat $10k credit for smaller pilots. Include conditional clause in proposal about non-transferable credits.

I'll edit the workbook and export a v1.1. Ben please verify the SLA language (regional failover + preemption policies). Marissa, can you prepare a one-slide appendix on warm-pool operational runbook?

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Reed <alicia@brightwell.ai>, Dan Cho <dan@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@brightwell.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated — ballpark sizing + timeline request

Thanks Dan / Alicia — updated pack attached (brightwell_reserved_options_v1.1.pdf) and pricing_workbook.xlsx (v1.1). Quick answers inline and highlights from the attachments:

1) Cost per 1M tokens (production baseline / 24 GPUs):
   - 60% util: ~$1,250 per 1M tokens
   - 85% util: ~$970 per 1M tokens
   (Workbook shows assumptions & sensitivity table)

2) Burst expansion notice:
   - Auto-burst (best-effort): immediate (requests routed to burst lanes) — typically effective within 2 hours depending on regional availability.
   - Guaranteed reserved burst: 48–72 hours lead time for steady-state reservation; can be pre-provisioned as part of a committed addendum.

3) Trial credits: we can offer the 30-day credit (10% of month-1 committed value) for deals that commit to a 12-month reserved contract or the flat $10k credit for pilots under that threshold. Terms in the PDF.

Next steps:
- If BrightWell is aligned with the Production baseline, we propose a short procurement call Thurs Jun 4 at 10am PT to run through procurement items and the SOW (I can loop Ben and Marissa).
- If you want the Scale-first option costed with multi-region standby, say so and we'll add an appendix.

Looking forward to the exec sync.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | www.redwood.ai
